EFFECTIVE_PACKAGE.rule: The effective authority is the ORDERED READ of all three authority files (and, for the manifest side, all three manifest files). Where a later file supersedes or qualifies an earlier one, the later file controls for that point only; everywhere else, silence means the earlier file controls verbatim.

RESIDUAL_SWEEP_METHOD.rule: Every string leaf of the base authority v1.0.0, the authority amendment v1.0.1, the base manifest v1.0.0 and the manifest amendment v1.0.1 was extracted by a RECURSIVE WALK of the parsed JSON — object keys, array indices, and every terminal string value — not a grep of clause ids. Each leaf was tested against eight patterns matching the family of Windows-delivery and OD-4-scope semantics named by the focused re-certification. Every hit was individually read in full context and classified as SUPERSEDED (the clause is corrected in this amendment), QUALIFIED (the clause is corrected in a narrower, disambiguating respect), or DEMONSTRATED_NOT_OBSOLETE (the text is either already the corrected/carried-forward form, an unrelated true statement the pattern matched incidentally, or a historical fact/adversarial-mutant description that was never itself the defect).
